figurative_meaning_bn: সু অর্থে- ধান চাষ হয় এমন; কু-অর্থে ধানচাষির মতো মূর্খ
figurative_meaning_en: In positive sense: suitable for rice cultivation; In negative sense: foolish like a rice farmer
similar_in_english: dumb as a rock (for negative sense)
example_sentences_in_bangla: এই জমিটি ধেনো, এখানে ভালো ধান উঠবে।
তার ধেনো বুদ্ধির জন্য সবাই হাসে।
example_sentences_in_english: This land is dheno, good rice will grow here.
Everyone laughs at his dheno intellect.
note: The idiom reflects Bengal's agrarian heritage, with dual connotations tied to rice farming.
